name: Google Antigravity
tagline: Google's agent-first development platform, where AI agents plan, write and check code across the editor, terminal and browser.
about: Antigravity is a development environment built around agents. You hand over a task, and agents plan it, make the changes and verify the result, while you review their work.
pros: Agents work across the editor, terminal and browser.
Several agents can work on tasks at the same time.
cons: Agent work needs review before you rely on it.
Team plans are paid per seat.
